release.name: Combat Style Modernisation
release.design_direction: Bring the original combat styles closer to Necromancy's clarity and modern design while preserving distinct identities and reducing action-bar/keybind bloat.

global_changes.change: Attack, Strength, Ranged and Magic level caps increased to 120.
A large set of combat auras was disabled as their power was moved into baseline combat progression.
Ability tutorialisation was modernised so newly unlocked abilities are explained rather than silently auto-added to action bars.
Magic and Ranged ammunition consumption was normalised as part of the wider Road to Restoration combat work.

style_identity.melee: Burst damage, bleeds and meaningful weapon-style choice, driven by the new Bloodlust resource.
style_identity.ranged: High hit frequency, ammunition identity and sustained ranged pressure; ammunition families were redesigned to interact more directly with abilities.
style_identity.magic: Critical-strike and burn/DoT oriented identity, with the modernisation reducing legacy bloat.
style_identity.necromancy: Used as the modern baseline for clarity and 120 progression; received adjustments so aura removal did not leave it behind.

bloodlust.summary: Basic abilities build Bloodlust and several adrenaline abilities consume or scale from it. Berserk expands the stack ceiling and accelerates generation.

important_abilities_after_initial_patche.name: Dismember
important_abilities_after_initial_patche.chain: enables Slaughter as the next bleed-chain cast

important_abilities_after_initial_patche.name: Massacre
important_abilities_after_initial_patche.damage: 110-130% initial hit plus 6 bleed hits at 100% each

important_abilities_after_initial_patche.name: Assault
important_abilities_after_initial_patche.damage: 4 channelled hits at 130-150% each; at 4 Bloodlust, 170-190% each

important_abilities_after_initial_patche.name: Punish
important_abilities_after_initial_patche.special_rule: Deals 2.5x damage to targets below 50% life points.

important_abilities_after_initial_patche.name: Berserk
important_abilities_after_initial_patche.bloodlust: +4 maximum stacks and +4 stacks on activation; basics generate double Bloodlust

important_abilities_after_initial_patche.name: Meteor Strike
important_abilities_after_initial_patche.summary: Area attack that also grants an adrenaline-generation buff.

important_abilities_after_initial_patche.name: Chaos Roar
important_abilities_after_initial_patche.summary: Empowers the next melee ability to 1.75x base damage and grants 1 Bloodlust.

ammo_system.name: Splintering arrows
ammo_system.effect: Ranged abilities apply Puncture. Each stack contributes 1% ability damage, up to 250 stacks, with a 30-second duration model after the modernisation.

ammo_system.name: Deathspore arrows
ammo_system.effect: Build stacks on hit rather than critical strikes; at 12 stacks they enable a free ability under the redesigned system.

important_ability_changes.name: Death's Swiftness
important_ability_changes.effect: Changed from a ground-targeted area into a self buff.

important_ability_changes.name: Bombardment
important_ability_changes.effect: Reworked into a multi-target bleed-oriented ability.

important_ability_changes.name: Shadow Tendrils
important_ability_changes.effect: No longer a threshold; deals 200-240% damage, is guaranteed to critically strike, and retains self-damage.

magic.identity: Critical strikes and burn damage-over-time are the defining modernised themes.
magic.data_status: High-level identity captured. Ability-by-ability table still needs a dedicated pass before being treated as optimizer-grade data.

aura_overhaul_follow_up.summary: The Aura Overhaul removed the aura system rather than preserving one-hour peak-efficiency windows. Beneficial effects were either folded into the core game, retired, or transformed into other unlock types.
aura_overhaul_follow_up.vampyrism_and_penance: Converted into sustain Aspects rather than remaining auras. They therefore compete in the Aspect system instead of stacking as an aura with another Aspect.
aura_overhaul_follow_up.later_aspect_qol: Jagex subsequently announced multi-casting so 12-minute Aspect durations can be stacked up to one hour by paying the corresponding rune cost.
aura_overhaul_follow_up.league_relevance: Do not import Catalyst guides that assume Berserker/Maniacal/Reckless, Vampyrism aura, Penance aura, aura refreshes, or aura timing into Equilibrium planning.
